units.source_text: 女公子入宫的仪式，源氏大臣并不过分铺张以惊人目，然而亦自十分体面，异乎寻常。

en.t: For the young lady's entrance into court, Minister Genji did not make a display so extravagant as to astonish people, yet the ceremony was dignified, elegant, and quite out of the ordinary.

units.source_text: 紫夫人真心疼爱这女公子，把她教养得慧美双全。

en.t: Lady Murasaki loved the young lady from the heart and raised her to be both wise and beautiful.

units.source_text: 她实在舍不得把她让给她的生母，心念如果是我亲生女儿，岂不更好。

en.t: She could hardly bear to yield her to her birth mother, thinking how much better it would be if the girl were truly her own daughter.

units.source_text: 源氏大臣与夕雾也都认为只此一事，实为美中不足。

en.t: Minister Genji and Yugiri also felt that this single matter was the one flaw in an otherwise perfect happiness.

units.source_text: 过了三天，紫夫人将出宫，是夜明石夫人入宫接替，二位夫人初次会面。

en.t: After three days, as Lady Murasaki was about to leave the palace, Lady Akashi entered that night to take her place, and the two ladies met for the first time.

units.source_text: 紫夫人对明石夫人言道：“女公子今已长大成人，可见我等共处已历多年，今后自当多多亲近，无所顾虑了。”

en.t: Lady Murasaki said to Lady Akashi, “The young lady is now grown. That shows how many years we have spent together, so from now on we should grow much closer without any reserve.”

units.source_text: 接着又讲了许多话，态度和蔼可亲。

en.t: She then spoke at length, with a manner that was gentle and approachable.

units.source_text: 明石夫人从此也就开诚解怀，对她无话不谈了。

en.t: From then on, Lady Akashi opened her heart as well and spoke to her about everything.

units.source_text: 紫夫人看了明石夫人应对辞令之文雅，心甚赞佩，始信源氏大臣宠爱她并非偶然。

en.t: Seeing the elegance of Lady Akashi's conversation and replies, Lady Murasaki deeply admired her and came to believe that Minister Genji's affection for her was no accident.

units.source_text: 明石夫人也真心敬仰紫夫人人品之高尚与容貌之丰丽，觉得源氏大臣于众夫人中特别宠爱此人，尊重她为最高无比的正夫人，确是理之当然。

en.t: Lady Akashi, too, sincerely revered Lady Murasaki's noble character and abundant beauty, and felt it was only natural that Minister Genji should cherish her above all his ladies and honor her as his incomparable principal wife.

units.source_text: 而回想自己能与此人同列，也是前世福报。

en.t: When she reflected that she herself could stand alongside such a woman, she felt it must be a blessing earned in a former life.

units.source_text: 但后来看见紫夫人出宫，仪式非常盛大，特许乘坐辇车，其尊贵与女御无异，比较之下，又觉得自己身份毕竟低微。

en.t: But later, when she saw Lady Murasaki leave the palace with an extremely splendid ceremony, specially permitted to ride in a hand-drawn carriage and honored no less than an imperial consort, she felt by comparison that her own rank was low after all.

units.source_text: 她看见女公子长得十分美丽，如同粉妆玉斫一般，欢喜之极，恍如身在梦中，眼泪流个不住，真所谓“一样泪流两般心”了。

en.t: When she saw how very beautiful the young lady had become, as if fashioned from powdered jade, she was overjoyed and felt as though she were in a dream; her tears would not stop, truly a case of the same tears flowing from two different hearts.

units.source_text: 多年以来，明石夫人受尽凄凉之苦，常觉此身忧患太多，毫无生趣。

en.t: For many years Lady Akashi had endured every sorrow of loneliness, often feeling that her life held too many troubles and no joy at all.

units.source_text: 现在心情忽然开朗，但愿寿命永远延长，方知住吉明神的确灵验。

en.t: Now her heart suddenly cleared, and she wished only that her life might be prolonged forever, realizing at last that the Sumiyoshi deity truly answered prayers.

units.source_text: 明石女公子在紫夫人膝下身受理想的教养，长大后非常贤惠，毫无半点缺陷。

en.t: The Akashi young lady received an ideal upbringing under Lady Murasaki's care, and when she grew up she was exceptionally virtuous, without the slightest flaw.

units.source_text: 世间声望之尊严自不必说，容貌仪态之娇艳亦无伦比。

en.t: Her dignified reputation in the world went without saying, and the charm of her beauty and bearing was also beyond compare.

units.source_text: 皇太子尚在童年，也知道特别怜爱这位妃子。

en.t: Although the Crown Prince was still a child, he knew enough to cherish this consort especially.

units.source_text: 与这妃子争宠的人向外扬言，说这妃子附带这个身份低微的母亲，实为一大缺憾。

en.t: Those who competed with this consort for favor spread word outside that it was a serious defect for her to be burdened with a mother of such low status.

units.source_text: 但这并不损害妃子的声望。

en.t: But this did not damage the consort's reputation.

units.source_text: 因为明石夫人非常贤能，不但把女公子的住处布置得优美入时，华丽无比，即使细微之处，亦都装点得风流优雅，巧妙精致。

en.t: For Lady Akashi was extremely capable, arranging the young lady's residence not only with fashionable beauty and unsurpassed splendor, but also decorating even the smallest details with refined elegance and delicate skill.

units.source_text: 于是殿上人等便把这宫殿看作珍奇的猎艳之场，大家都来向这里的侍女们调情。

en.t: Thus the courtiers came to regard this palace as a rare hunting ground for romance, and they all visited to flirt with the serving women there.

units.source_text: 因此连侍女们的风度与姿态也都特别讲究。

en.t: As a result, even the manners and bearing of the serving women became especially refined.

units.source_text: 每逢适当时节，紫夫人也入宫来探视。

en.t: Whenever the proper occasion arose, Lady Murasaki also came into the palace to visit.

units.source_text: 她和明石夫人的交情越来越深，彼此都无顾虑了。

en.t: Her friendship with Lady Akashi grew deeper and deeper, until neither held back from the other.

units.source_text: 明石夫人对她既不过分放肆，又毫不卑屈，举止态度都很恰当，真是不可多得的理想人物。

en.t: Toward her, Lady Akashi was neither overly familiar nor at all servile; her conduct and manner were perfectly appropriate, making her a rare and ideal person.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣自念寿命所余无多，渴望于生前完成女公子入宫之事，如今果然如愿以偿了。

en.t: The Grand Minister Genji, believing he had little life left, had longed to complete the young lady's entrance into court while he was still alive, and now his wish had indeed been fulfilled.

units.source_text: 还有，夕雾婚事纠纷不已，虽是他自己固执之故，外闻总不好听，而如今也已美满成就，如意称心了。

en.t: Moreover, Yugiri's marriage affair had been full of trouble, and although it was due to his own stubbornness, the rumors had always sounded bad; now, however, it too had ended happily and to everyone's satisfaction.

units.source_text: 因此源氏太政大臣心无挂碍，今后当可成遂出家之本愿了。

en.t: For this reason the Grand Minister Genji had no further attachments weighing on his heart, and from now on he could presumably fulfill his long-cherished wish to take religious vows.

units.source_text: 只是舍不得紫夫人，但有义女秋好皇后照顾，大可放心；还有明石女公子，其正式的母亲是紫夫人，今后对她亦必竭诚孝养。

en.t: He was only reluctant to leave Lady Murasaki, but with his adopted daughter, Empress Akikonomu, to care for her, he could be at ease; moreover, since the Akashi young lady's official mother was Lady Murasaki, she too would surely serve her with wholehearted devotion in the future.

units.source_text: 故即使出家，亦可将夫人托付二人供养。

en.t: Thus even if he entered religion, he could entrust his lady to those two for her support.

units.source_text: 花散里虽然寂寞寡欢，但有义子夕雾奉养。

en.t: Although Hanachirusato was lonely and had little joy, her adopted son Yugiri would provide for her.

units.source_text: 诸人各得其所，可无后顾之忧了。

en.t: Everyone had found a fitting place, and there was no longer any cause for worry about those left behind.
